vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's a sunny day at the playground!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hi, friends! I'm Spark Girl! I love the swing!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But look! Leo is on the swing.

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Wheee! Higher and higher!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: My turn! My turn! I want the swing NOW!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hurry up, Leo! Hurry, hurry, hurry!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: But I just got on...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Leo feels rushed. And Mila feels impatient. Her feet go stomp, stomp, stomp!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Impatient means, it's hard to wait.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Waiting is hard! Can you help Mila? What can she do?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Mila! I know a waiting game. It has three steps!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step one. Ask nicely. Say: Can I have the next turn, please?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Leo, can I have the next turn, please?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Sure, Mila! You're next!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you say it with Mila? Can I have the next turn, please? Your turn!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step two. Count to ten. When the sand runs out, it's your turn!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bobo turns over his sand timer. Let's count together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Two!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Three!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Four!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Five!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Six!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Seven!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Eight!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Nine!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ten!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ten! The sand is all gone!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Here you go, Mila! Your turn!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Thank you, Leo! Wheee!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Waiting was hard. But Mila did it! And the swing feels even better now!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Later, the friends paint pictures in the classroom.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look! I painted a big rainbow! I want to hang it up right now!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Wait, Mila! The paint is still wet!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Uh-oh! Mila lifts it too fast. Drip, drip! The colors run.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Oh no! My rainbow is all drippy!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Don't worry! Let's paint a new one, and use step three!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step three. Find something fun to do while you wait!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can Mila do while the paint dries? Can you think of something?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: I know! I can sing a song while it dries!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: La la la, the paint is drying, la la la!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And I can build a tower! One block, two blocks, three blocks!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The sun shines through the window, and the paint dries.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: It's dry! Now I can hang it up!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Wow! Your rainbow is beautiful, Mila!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Waiting made it even better!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When it's hard to wait, play the waiting game!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember the waiting game!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Step one. Ask nicely!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Step two. Count to ten!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step three. Find something fun to do!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does impatient mean?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: It's hard to wait!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Mila say to Leo? Can you say it?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Can I have the next turn, please?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why did Mila's first rainbow get drippy?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The paint was still wet!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can YOU do while you wait?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Sing a song, build a tower, or read a book!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How long did Mila wait for the swing? Until the sand ran out, and she counted to...

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ten!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say the waiting game together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ask nicely, count to ten, find something fun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ask nicely, count to ten, find something fun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One more time, all together!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ask nicely, count to ten, find something fun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now you count to ten, all by yourself! Watch the sand. Ready? Go!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: You did it! You can wait!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Thank you for waiting with me!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What will YOU do, the next time you have to wait?
